item.title: Version 0.18.1
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.18.1

Improvements

  • Tighter Recents Spacing: Recent links now sit flush with saved links in the sidebar.
  • Rename From the Right-Click Menu: Rename a link directly from its right-click menu, without opening the Edit sheet.

Bug Fixes

  • Website Shortcut Stays Focused: With a website shortcut like gh active, the command panel only shows that site’s search row and matching saved links.
  • Auto-Update Link Recovers After a Save Failure: A failed save now retries on the next page visit instead of getting stuck on the old URL.
  • Rapid Space Switching With Linked Profiles: Holding the next-space shortcut now advances reliably when a space is linked to a browser profile.
